g1.label: 1. Big Ben is located ___ the northern end
g1.why: “at” marks a precise point → at the northern end.

g2.label: 2. Westminster Bridge crosses ___ the Thames
g2.why: A bridge goes across → over the river.

g3.label: 3. Buckingham Palace is ___ The Mall
g3.why: It stands where The Mall ends → at the end of.

g4.label: 4. The Tower of London stands ___ the north bank
g4.why: Position on a surface/bank → on the bank.

g5.label: 5. The Changing of the Guard takes place ___ the palace
g5.why: It happens ahead of the palace → in front of.

g6.label: 6. a beautiful view ___ the Houses of Parliament
g6.why: Fixed phrase: a view of something → of.
